capabilities.surface: The wiki/governance pipeline itself: seed doc -> rules ingest/fanout -> rules.recall (installed estate MCP) -> governed-run gate denial -> ConformanceClaim in the acceptance payload
capabilities.apis: wicked-core rules ingest/fanout (wicked-core src/bin/wicked-core.rs:333-349); estate MCP rules.recall (wicked-estate crates/wicked-estate-retrieve/src/rules_recall.rs:116); crew POST /api/v1/governance/policies + /rules (wicked-crew packages/crew/src/api/routes.ts:1519-1530); gate decide + recall-to-obligation (wicked-core src/execute.rs:135, crates/wicked-governance/src/engine.rs:224); GET /api/v1/runs/:id/acceptance conformance section (wicked-crew packages/crew/src/qe/conformance.ts:1)
capabilities.test_shape: PASS = run.sh exit 0: fanout manifest records 3 lanes; rules.recall returns POL-2500 with provenance ref aw25-golden.md@<blob sha>#POL-2500; the governed run reaches a terminal state with a run-scoped deny claim naming POL-2500 whose text cites wiki://aw25-golden#POL-2500; GET /runs/:id/acceptance shows conformance.denied=true, guardrailed=false, summary citing POL-2500
capabilities.needs: isolated crew daemon (79xx port, scratch --db/--bus-db, WICKED_CREW_PROJECT_GRAPH_ROOT + WICKED_ESTATE_REPO_GRAPH_ROOT pinned); wicked-core binary with the rules subcommands (main >= #310); crew build with the acceptance conformance section (main >= #359); installed wicked-estate-mcp >= 0.15.1; a signed-in claude seat for the canary worker

scenarios.title: AW-25 golden path: the wiki pipeline's own evidence-gated proof (arch-R21)

pass_criteria.terminal_state: the governed canary run reaches failed/completed/cancelled (never left executing or awaiting_human)
pass_criteria.artifact: numbered evidence chain 00-07 written by run.sh: fanout manifest + crew payload, rules.recall response with provenance citation, run-scoped deny claim, acceptance payload
pass_criteria.consumer_state: GET /runs/:id/acceptance re-derives the denial: conformance.denied=true, deny claim policyIds=[POL-2500] with the wiki URI in its cited statement, guardrailed=false
